messages:
jess: quick idea — want to add a Console tile that surfaces adaptive-quota usage and per-route telemetry. question: do we need SDKs to emit a tiny route/intent tag so the Console can join metrics? :thinking:

dan: love the tile. main constraints: must be opt-in, tiny header, no perf hit on p99. also watch proxy/charset issues.

rachel: +1 single compact header if we do this. we already have x-rw-affinity for session routing; prefer not to proliferation of headers.

jess: proposal: a single header `x-rw-route-meta` carrying short semicolon-separated k=v pairs (no json) — easy to parse in edge proxies and servers. example: `x-rw-route-meta: q=high;intent=chat;s=0.01`

oliver: curious — why not base64/json? pros/cons: base64 keeps structure but makes tracing harder in dashboards. semicolon k=v is ok but define escaping. proxies sometimes normalize case — use lower-case header.

sam: SDK note: py/ts trivial. go needs a typed accessor in the client. proposal: opt-in flag in clients: `enable_route_meta` default false so we avoid breaking behavior. rollout with a minor version bump.

sdk-bot: created issue RW-1234 in sdks repo: "add x-rw-route-meta support + opt-in config" — https://git.internal/rw/sdks/issues/1234 :memo:

jess: rollout plan sketch: 1) ship Console tile that uses existing telemetry (no new headers). 2) after tile is live, ship SDK opt-in so we can correlate client-sent route-meta with console charts. 3) enable canary customers (feature flag) to validate. target: 2 sprints.

rachel: telemetry sampling: include `s=` for sample rate so backend knows when to upweight. e.g. `s=0.01` for 1%. also include a short route tag `r=` if teams want to correlate routes without exposing tenant ids.

dan: tracing: add an OTEL attribute `route.meta` (string) populated from header in our trace-ingest. docs must map header -> metric/tag -> trace attr. I'll add mapping table.

oliver: quick examples to include in the SDK issues:```python
# python
resp = requests.post(url, headers={"x-rw-route-meta": "q=high;intent=chat;s=0.01"})
``` ```go
// go
req.Header.Set("x-rw-route-meta", "q=high;intent=chat;s=0.01")
``` ```ts
// ts
fetch(url, { headers: { 'x-rw-route-meta': 'q=high;intent=chat;s=0.01' } })
```

sam: thanks — for Go I'm thinking API: `client.WithRouteMeta(map[string]string)` that serializes to semicolon format. will PR the shape. we should also include tests for header length (limit to 256 bytes?).

jess: good call on length cap. also QA checklist: ensure no token leakage, ensure header not logged by default sinks, and confirm no quota double-counting when backend reconstructs metrics.

dan: one more: add a feature-flag gate in the proxy so customers can opt out globally even if SDKs send the header.

jess: action items: I'll drop a short design doc + Console mock. @sam please link SDK issue RW-1234 to that doc. @dan add OTEL mapping RW-1235. We'll sync next Tue. :thumbsup:

sam: will do. tagging infra folks for proxy-gate: @rachel FYI. :eyes:

rachel: noted. I'll scope proxy toggle and logging changes.

jess: thanks all — imma open the PR for the console mock now.
__notes: Thread is a single continuous Slack conversation string with short messages, lightweight code examples, emoji, and a created SDK issue link. All timestamps are strings per agents.md requirements.
